name: plugin
title: rosync plugin
description: Atomically installs the bundled Roblox Studio Plugin.rbxm or compares the installed copy with the bundle by SHA-256.
notes: The default destination is ~/Documents/Roblox/Plugins on macOS and LocalAppData/Roblox/Plugins on Windows.
Installation removes stale RoSync.lua and RoSync.luau copies and reports that Studio must be restarted.
